phase1.explanation:
🦀 **The ? operator propagates errors.**

**? operator rules:**

| Rule | What it means |
|------|---------------|
| Returns Ok | Continues |
| Returns Err | Returns early |
| Requires Result | Function must return Result |

**Rust-chan says:**
"The ? operator makes error handling concise."

**Where ? can be used:**
| Context | Can use ? |
|---------|-----------|
| Function returning Result | ✅ |
| Function returning Option | ✅ |
| main returning Result | ✅ |
| Elsewhere | ❌ |
